pairs: Locutus est autem David Domino verba carminis hujus in die qua liberavit eum Dominus de manu omnium inimicorum suorum,
And David spoke to the Lord the words of this verse,
in the day that the Lord freed him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.
scutum meum, et cornu salutis meæ:
my shield, and the horn of my salvation.
I will call upon the Lord, who is praiseworthy;
et ab inimicis meis salvus ero.
and I will be saved from my enemies.
For the pangs of death have encircled me.
The torrents of Belial have terrified me.
The ropes of Hell have encompassed me.
The snares of death have intercepted me.
In my tribulation, I will call upon the Lord,
and I will cry out to my God.
et exaudiet de templo suo vocem meam,
And he will heed my voice from his temple,
et clamor meus veniet ad aures ejus.
and my outcry will reach his ears.
The foundations of the mountains were struck together and violently shaken,
because he was angry with them.
et ignis de ore ejus vorabit:
and fire from his mouth will devour;
coals have been kindled by it.
and a fog was beneath his feet.
And he climbed upon the cherubim,
et lapsus est super pennas venti.
and he slid upon the wings of the wind.
Posuit tenebras in circuitu suo latibulum,
He set darkness as a hiding place around himself,
with waters sifted from the clouds of the heavens.
By means of the brightness of his glance,
The Lord will thunder from heaven;
and the Most High will utter his voice.
And the overflow of the sea appeared,
et revelata sunt fundamenta orbis ab increpatione Domini,
and the foundations of the globe were revealed, at the rebuke of the Lord,
at the exhale of the breath of his fury.
et extraxit me de aquis multis.
And he drew me out of many waters.
Liberavit me ab inimico meo potentissimo,
He freed me from my most powerful enemy
et ab his qui oderant me:
and from those who had hated me.
For they were too strong for me.
Prævenit me in die afflictionis meæ,
He went before me in the day of my affliction,
et factus est Dominus firmamentum meum.
and the Lord became my firmament.
And he led me out to a wide-open place.
because I was pleasing to him.
Retribuet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam:
The Lord will reward me according to my justice.
et secundum munditiam manuum mearum reddet mihi.
And he will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands.
For I have kept to the ways of the Lord,
et non egi impie a Deo meo.
and I have not acted impiously before my God.
Omnia enim judicia ejus in conspectu meo,
For all his judgments are in my sight.
et præcepta ejus non amovi a me.
And I have not removed his precepts from me.
And I shall be perfect with him.
et custodiam me ab iniquitate mea.
And I shall guard myself from my own iniquity.
Et restituet mihi Dominus secundum justitiam meam,
And the Lord will recompense me according to my justice,
et secundum munditiam manuum mearum in conspectu oculorum suorum.
and according to the cleanness of my hands in the sight of his eyes.
With the holy one, you will be holy,
and with the strong one, you will be perfect.
With the elect one, you will be elect,
and with the perverse one, you will be perverse.
And you will bring to salvation the poor people,
and you will humble the exalted with your eyes.
For in you, I will run girded.
In my God, I will leap over the wall.
the eloquence of the Lord is an exacting fire.
scutum est omnium sperantium in se.
He is the shield of all who hope in him.
Who is God except the Lord?
et quis fortis præter Deum nostrum?
And who is strong except our God?
God, he has girded me with fortitude,
and he has made my way perfect:
making my feet like the feet of the stag,
et super excelsa mea statuens me;
and stationing me upon my exalted places,
teaching my hands to do battle,
et componens quasi arcum æreum brachia mea.
and making my arms like a bow of brass.
You have given me the shield of your salvation.
And your mildness has multiplied me.
You will enlarge my steps under me,
and my ankles will not fail.
et non convertar donec consumam eos.
And I will not turn back, until I consume them.
I will consume them and break them apart,
so that they cannot rise up;
they will fall under my feet.
You have girded me with strength for the battle.
Those who resisted me, you have bent down under me.
You have caused my enemies to turn their back to me;
and there will be no one to save;
and he will not heed them.
I will wipe them away like the dust of the earth.
I will break them apart and crush them,
like the mud of the streets.
Salvabis me a contradictionibus populi mei;
You will save me from the contradictions of my people.
You will preserve me to be the head of the Gentiles;
a people I do not know shall serve me.
The sons of foreigners, who will resist me,
at the hearing of the ear they will be obedient to me.
but they will be drawn together in their anguishes.
et exaltabitur Deus fortis salutis meæ.
And the strong God of my salvation shall be exalted.
and he casts down the peoples under me.
Qui educis me ab inimicis meis,
He leads me away from my enemies,
et a resistentibus mihi elevas me:
and he lifts me up from those who resist me.
You will free me from the iniquitous man.
Because of this, I will confess to you,
and I will sing to your name:
magnifying the salvation of his king,
et faciens misericordiam christo suo David,
and showing mercy to David, his Christ,
